status: Source candidate; independent source acceptance and licensed compile/build/native gates remain separate. Fresh-game/fresh-save only.
baselineAttributes:
# Plugins are binary; never let git touch their bytes.
*.esp binary
*.esm binary
*.esl binary
*.pex binary

# The plugin builder keeps this file in LF on every machine (see Builder.Create).
tools/PluginBuilder/formkeys.txt text eol=lf

# Frozen creative packets have byte-level hashes; keep checkout bytes portable.
docs/design/ACT1_APPROVED_TEXT_REVISIONS_2026-11-16.json text eol=lf
docs/design/ACT1_BALLAD_ADDENDUM_2026-11-16.json text eol=lf
docs/design/ACT1_WRITING_CLOSURE_PACKET_2.json text eol=lf
docs/design/ACT1_WRITING_CLOSURE_PACKET_3.json text eol=lf

# The four earlier package manifests are pinned byte for byte by the Mercy
# briefing candidate's check (tools/mercy_briefing_candidate.py). Their
# committed bytes are LF; a checkout must write the same bytes on every
# machine. This changes no byte in the repository. A working copy made before
# these rules keeps the line ends it was written with until those four files
# are written again (docs/design/ACT1_RUNTIME_001_LEDGER.md, section 13).
tools/win/world-details-artifact.json text eol=lf
tools/win/world-natural-artifact.json text eol=lf
tools/win/world-story-artifact.json text eol=lf
tools/WorldSliceBuilder/expanded-artifact.json text eol=lf

# Pictures are binary too.
*.png binary

# Story implementation orders and independent contract receipts are frozen inputs.
docs/design/GREENWATER_STORY_001*.md text eol=lf

runtimeSelection.policy: Reuse only unchanged source with measured Details PEX pins. Full fresh compile is separate proof; its reviewed 17 files are not bundled. No byte reproducibility assumption.
